risk_description: Backstage steps may be oversimplified in paper representation
Interactive mockup may hide integration and data-flow complexity
Participants may disclose stressful service experiences during role play
Pilot may work under protected staffing conditions that cannot be sustained
Participants may overtrust simulated automation if status is unclear
Exception cases may reveal unresolved decision-rights conflicts
Simplified language may conflict with formal eligibility language
Decision authority may remain unresolved after simulation
